reader_images: All source image bytes embedded in index.html; no image network or sibling-folder requests needed.

semantics.robot_id: YEAR-TEAM; team number alone is ambiguous
semantics.image_paths: Relative to corpus root, including inside packets; never relative to the packet file
semantics.units: Published strings retain source units and ratio order. No automatic physical normalization.
semantics.version_groups: Publication labels, not audited competition intervals. Null dates mean unknown.
semantics.evidence: Types describe attribution, not calibrated probabilities. Analyst inference is not a team statement. Proposed tests are not performed.
semantics.search_ranking: FTS5 bm25 lexical relevance only; not confidence, causation, robot quality or EPA.
semantics.field_sourcing: Technical notes have source/page locators; dossier synopsis fields retain coarser source bundles.
semantics.manuals: Source links and narrative references are retained; rule-version completeness and field CAD coverage are not certified. Verify governing rules for a new design.
semantics.scope: 143 provisional dossiers: original125, three604 supplements, thirteen2018/2019 curated studies and two targeted2023 architecture supplements (1746,6328). Ranked cohorts and prior source/video scopes preserved. Five architecture cases are source-bounded engineering analyses, not controlled performance comparisons. Zero exhaustive version certifications.
semantics.revision_history: Publisher prototype ordinals are independent per mechanism. Do not assign final feature-list specifications backward to every prototype, or pair rotor and shooter ordinals without an explicit source. A changed render pose is not proof of a hardware revision.
semantics.physical_evidence: Source-bounded editorial reconstruction; explicit unknowns and inspected figure scope travel with every integrated mechanism hit. Editorial drawings are not inspected source images or measured CAD.
semantics.coverage: Legacy description fields do not establish completeness. Read explicit supported/partial/unknown/not_applicable evidence assessments, including unassessed legacy rows.

required_workflow: Read AGENTS.md and the full game chapter for the target year.

Read docs/1833_PLAIN_LANGUAGE_AND_PHYSICAL_DESIGN.md. Explain actual construction, borrowed features, packaging and full piece cycles in plain language; calculations must constrain choices. Apply the revised rubric anchors.

Read ARCHITECTURE_RESEARCH_PROTOCOL.md; agent owns discovery and causal engineering explanation. Compare full architectures and cost vectors, preserve owner testimony, counterevidence and reversal conditions. Ask only consequential unresolved questions.
Apply the 1833 owner mandate: elite primary contributor, no support-only architecture, no turret; establish event stage, partners and actual resources.
No pneumatic actuation for 1833. Respect historical scope; 2018/2019 now have thirteen curated primary-source studies; read the scope audit and transfer guide, not an assumed top25 cohort.
For historical transfer, read HISTORICAL_2018_2019_TRANSFER.md; compare whole mechanisms and preserve current owner constraints, source/version boundaries and null historical rankings.

Prioritize independently achievable RP and owned scoring prerequisites. Use cheap spatial/analytical decisions first and justify physical tests by decision value and iteration cost; preserve the owner four-lane decision chronology.

For each new manual analysis, material rules revision or new/revised robot design brief, follow docs/TASK_LIST_PROTOCOL.md and deliver a filled copy of the one-sheet 1833 task template before the final architecture recommendation. Preserve human decisions separately; no group tabs.

Follow DESIGN_REVIEW_PROTOCOL.md: compare viable primary non-turret architectures with common timed scenarios, capacity/storage trade studies, physical envelope, row-specific dependencies and consistent release targets; apply the rubric and human review.
Search explicit year/function; inspect typed evidence, scope and source locators.
Load complete robot packets, including sibling claim fields and limitations.
Open the referenced image bytes with image-capable tools; text captions do not confer visual understanding.
Check exact version, mechanism interfaces, performance conditions and rule applicability.
Recommend a coherent architecture, alternatives, unresolved issues and a decision-changing test.

For physical studies, retrieve kind physical_mechanism and interface ports; never infer drop-in compatibility from shared piece type or a schematic. Use compare-interfaces to expose unresolved checks.

For sources with revision galleries, query mechanism_revision and inspect each relevant revision before transferring final feature-list parameters. Prototype labels do not establish a competition configuration or a rotor/shooter pairing.
Open source_review in selected robot packets where present. Preserve version scope and evidence limits. Coverage ledger lists robots still awaiting a deeper review.
